english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for feeling happy or enjoying oneself.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for feeling pleased or happy.
This is the all-purpose choice for people who are happy, jolly, or in high spirits.
This is the all-purpose spoken choice for feeling happy or pleased.
This is the all-purpose choice for someone who is noticeably happy and cheerful.
Use this when the pleasant experience mainly makes someone feel happy or cheerful.
Use this when the focus is on the happiness or good feelings the experience gives someone.
Choose this when the pleasurable thing mainly makes someone feel happy or is enjoyable as an activity.
Use this for someone who feels happy or whose expression looks happy, such as when saying that someone looks cheerful.
